title: pfaffia lanata var. latifolia
intro: Pfaffia lanata var. latifolia, commonly known as Suma, is a plant species native to South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pfaffia lanata var. latifolia include its ability to stimulate the immune system, act as a diuretic, and have a potential effect on the central nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
